programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.sub-title: A countdown of the top 20 internet legends. From lighting matches with bullets to kayaking in the snow, this features only the smartest and bravest humankind has to offer!
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: Reveals the mouthwatering secrets behind tasty treats. It's a wild culinary ride as mountains of raw materials are transformed. Featuring sweet chai and coconut and Lindt cocoa
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: The Mind Control Freaks
programme.sub-title: Pete and Alex stage a robbery and convince witnesses the wrong man carried out the crime. Lewis wins a bet that people can't remember their PIN and Liv proves how easy it is to miss something that's staring you right in the face
programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured. The show features master manipulators, including professional poker player Liv Boeree and mentalism expert Lewis Le Val, who use their abilities to influence others' actions. The results of some of their experiments include a man forgetting his fiancee, strangers giving away their car keys, and a boxer becoming unable to crush a foam cup.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: CRIME FILES
programme.desc: It All Begins Around Us This Crime Show Explores Crimes That Occur Within Our Own Communities And Among People We Know. It Tells The Compelling Stories Of Ordinary Lives Disrupted By Crime, With Relatable Characters Representing The World Around Us. The Show'S Mission Is To Raise Awareness About Crime Prevention While Keeping Viewers Engaged And Intrigued."

programme.title: LOVE MARRIAGE
programme.desc: A Drama Where A Couple Defies Societal Norms And Family Opposition To Unite For Love. Facing Cultural Clashes, Emotional Turmoil, And Personal Sacrifices, Their Journey Tests The Strength Of Their Bond And The Power Of True Commitment.

programme.title: SAAS KAMAAL BAHU DHAMAAL
programme.desc: Saas Kamaal Bahu Dhamaal” (2024) Is A Bhojpuri Comedy–Drama Starring Amrapali Dubey, Mani Bhattacharya, And Sohel Sheikh. Set In The Cursed Village Of Jhakjhorpur, The Film Explores The Eternal Conflict Between Saas (Mother-In-Law) And Bahu (Daughter-In-Law), Blending Humor With A Social Message

programme.title: SEETA AUR GEETA
programme.desc: The Story Is About Twin Sisters, One Of Whom Dies Due To Dowry-Related Abuse. Her Spirit Enters The Other Sister To Seek Revenge.

programme.title: The Fix

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: One family in a small town in the Pacific Northwest seems to have it all, until a secret video and a stash of guns reveals the face of a diabolical killer.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The team head to the Old Idaho State Penitentiary. Here, they hope to encounter the spirits of two infamous murderers who are rumoured to haunt the building.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: A hooded gunman shoots and kills Donna Willard while her son watches from the top of the stairs.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Ryan is climbing the career ladder and all he needs for a perfect life is the perfect woman to share it with. But is the beautiful Jodi as impeccable as she seems?

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Beverly Carter is a 50-year-old internet savvy real-estate agent. But when she goes to meet a prospective buyer at a remote house, she never returns.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: In Alabama, murder is on the menu at a party after one family's distrust and finger pointing lead detectives on a cross-country search for a killer.

programme.title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
programme.desc: UFO experts Mitch Horowitz and Chrissy Newton use scientific data and research to dissect real-life encounters with extraterrestrial activity and determine whether they can be explained.

programme.title: Who the (Bleep) Did I Marry?
programme.desc: Telling the real stories of men and women who lived happy, seemingly normal lives with the people they loved - and who they thought they knew. When a clue or mishap causes them to dig further into the secret lives of their spouses, the shocking truths lead them to wonder who it is they really fell in love with. The stories include husbands with multiple families, spies working under cover, those who steal thousands of dollars, and others whose double lives include murder.

programme.title: Redrum
programme.desc: As its title implies, `Redrum' works in reverse. The true crime series flips the script of traditional mystery programming by starting the stories at the scene of the crimes and working backward to reveal the killers. Told with the help of interviews with friends and family close to the victim - and sometimes even the killer - each story integrates the interviews with stylised re-creations to show how investigators piece together a case, tracing a series of intersecting events and relationships that unfolded to arrive at the root of the crime.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Following real-life murder investigation as it is being conducted in real time, using raw and unfiltered footage, including body-cam and surveillance footage, to bring out the truth.

programme.title: Shattered
programme.desc: Exploring the ripple effects of a single murder on multiple lives, as loved ones, eyewitnesses and law enforcement personnel reflect on how the past continues to haunt the present.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: A retelling of the truly chilling, real-life stories of people who shared their homes and their lives with loved ones who turned into killers. Plus, interviews and firsthand accounts of the critical moments leading up to the vicious acts.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Here today, gone tomorrow. Thousands of people go missing in the United States each year, leaving behind only a mystery without any clues. Their stories are told in `Disappeared' through the voices of family, friends and investigators trying to solve the case, with each hourlong episode recounting the final stages that led to a person's disappearance. Interviews with experts including psychologists and forensic specialists provide new insights into what may have happened - whether foul play was involved or the subject simply ran away.

programme.title: Ghost Asylum
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers (TWC) are passionate paranormal investigators. The team have a specific niche in the supernatural realm - seeking out activity at asylums, sanitariums and mental hospitals. Unlike other teams, TWC isn't content to conjure up incorporeal beings and collect evidence; it uses traps to capture restless spirits. With common sense and adventurous tendencies, the team either debunk or validate each case it researches, whose venues include hospitals where dead nurses roam the halls and a rehab center that has cries coming from the windows.

programme.title: Blood Relatives
programme.desc: From the outside, families seem like harmonious units in loving homes. But you don't necessarily know what secrets families are hiding from the outside world. This series, narrated by actress Brenda Strong, explores families hiding the most extreme of family secrets: murder. Each episode explores a death in a family, unravelling the motives of the family members, all of whom are potential suspects - and potential victims. Sibling rivalries, disputes over family businesses and infidelity are some of the factors that lead to the families' ultimate betrayals.

programme.title: True Conviction
programme.desc: Anna-Sigga Nicolazzi examines cases through the eyes of a prosecutor and shares her insights into how the complex threads of a murder investigation come together in the courtroom.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. Each hour-long episode follows Bagans, Groff and Goodwin as they work to uncover the paranormal mysteries, and after piecing together the haunted history of each site, the team holds a dusk-to-dawn `lockdown' in an effort to obtain physical evidence of the paranormal and discover the truth.

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Don't Hate the Player, Hate the Game Jamie (Jamie Foxx) plots to have Fancy's (Garcelle Beauvais) new boyfriend, Silas (guest star Alan F. Smith), get caught in a compromising situation.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E03 — MEN-O-pause Junior (Garrett Morris) is chagrined when a slim Helen (Ellia English) starts getting attention from men.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E04 — Swing Out Sister Jamie's fortune-seeking sister may find the wrong kind of fame when she gets invited to a wild party.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Is There a Doctor in the House? Jamie (Jamie Foxx) takes Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais) to her 10-year high-school reunion after her boyfriend Silas (guest star Alan F. Smith) is delayed.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner Braxton's (Christopher B. Duncan) secret relationship with Cameron (Susan Wood) causes trouble when an old flame (guest star Tembi Locke) comes to town.
programme.title: The Jamie Foxx Show

programme.desc: S41 E13 — They Are Like Cockroaches The challengers are sent on the heist of a century to collect a key using… haystacks. This exhausting challenge is a crucial look into everyone's speed and endurance, and one team's performance is shocking to everyone.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E14 — We Have to Boogie! As the numbers whittle down, everyone's collective performance in the challenge becomes crucial because winning or losing takes a vote away from their alliance; how important is your own safety versus your team's safety?
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E15 — The Best Birthday Present In a challenge filled with chains, the players must trust their partner's driving skills to help them succeed; if you love rummaging through your junk drawer and unraveling cable, this elimination won't be one to miss.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E16 — Am I Being Bamboozled? The challengers must navigate a harrowing and pitch-black cave in hopes of earning safety; the teams in elimination must cram into a replica airplane bathroom, and it's not even close to the mile high club.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E17 — Ten Toes Down An argument creates tension in the house and reveals who's been playing honest and how devious the game can really be; a headbanger awaits the teams in elimination, and it's more than just their life in the game.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S41 E18 — Finale Part I After a grueling season, the final four teams have made it to TJ's Final; while battling exhaustion, the players must complete grueling runs, mind-numbing checkpoints and the ultimate temptation to become Challenge Champions; that's only day one.
programme.title: The Challenge

programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Ink Will Speak for Itself Eighteen artists arrive ready to fight for themselves but instead find they must work in teams divided by gender; battle lines are drawn, then tested, in the "Ink Master" Battle of the Sexes; in the end, only one will win $100,000.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E02 — A Storm Is Brewin' Team leaders emerge in a shocking new season-long twist that sends the Artists a wake-up call and shakes up the competition; The Battle of the Sexes continues for $100K and the title of Ink Master.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E03 — Down to the Wire The artists must fight even harder to win the Battle of the Sexes as the field thins and the competition intensifies; one artist is not wired properly for the competition and must pack up and close shop.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E04 — The Hunter & the Hunted The judges are looking for color contrast and the artists are out for blood with full color neo-traditional animal tattoos.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E05 — The Art Stands Alone It's every man or woman for themselves when the artists are subject to a blind critique.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E06 — Art of War The artists must put needle to skin consistently to take out their competitors; the battle of the sexes continues for $100K and the title of Ink Master.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E07 — Sabotage The artists must prove their strength by facing off against each other.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E08 — Pins & No Needles The judges test the artists' understanding of color theory; two coaches take the artists to school; the battle intensifies for $100K and the title of "Ink Master."
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E09 — Drawing Alliances The teams are out of balance as the artists cross enemy battle lines to pick secret alliances; a freehand drawing challenge tests the competitors' artistic ability.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E10 — By Accident or By Design The battle for the grand prize and title of Ink Master continues as the judges test the artist's adaptability.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E11 — Roll of the Dice The Artists find themselves in a dicey situation with confrontational coaches Josh Payne and Nikki Simpson.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E12 — Put Your Ink Where Your Mouth Is The competition tests the artists' ability to market themselves when the power is in the hands of the canvases.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E13 — Moving Pictures The artists are on their own in a test of finesse as the six remaining competitors fight for the cash prize and the title of Ink Master.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E14 — Unfriendly Fire It's a battle of the sexes as the men's team takes aim at the women during an illustrative portrait challenge.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E15 — Step Up or Shut Up The last four artists remaining battle it out in a tattoo marathon to secure their spot in the season finale.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.desc: S12 E16 — Battle of the Sexes Finale Seven veteran artists battle it out in the "Clash of the Coaches Face Off"; the battle of the sexes comes to an end as the three finalists reveal their 35-hour Master Canvas tattoos and one artist wins the title of Ink Master.
programme.title: Ink Master

programme.title: Chalta Hai Yaar

programme.title: Yeh Lamhe Judaai Ke

programme.title: Speed
programme.desc: A woman is held captive by a group of kidnappers to compel her MI5 husband to exterminate the prime minister of the country.

programme.title: Hum Hain Lajawab

programme.title: J.D.
programme.desc: JD, an ambitious journalist known for integrity, spirals into addiction and scandal. Subsequently, his career and reputation crumble when he's accused of raping a colleague who works for him.

programme.title: I M 24
programme.desc: A 42-year-old writer falls in love with a 22-year-old beauty queen. However, things get complicated when his roommate encourages him to make up stories to impress her.

programme.title: Nayee Padosan
programme.desc: Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community.

programme.title: Kuchh Meetha Ho Jaye

programme.title: Ek Chitthi Pyar Bhari

programme.title: Aavishkar

programme.title: ViR: The Robot Boy

programme.desc: An oddball buddy series between an over ambitious boy, Jack and his pal Moose, a melodramatic self-confessed expert in everything. Except he isn' t! Despite his best intentions, he always messes up and although Jack may not get what he want, you can' t help being sucked in by Moose' s relentless optimism and zest for life!

programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: Eliot Kid
programme.desc: When a tooth falling out turns into a hunt for the “giant mouse”, when the city's sewers transform into Indiana Jones' white rapids or when a trip to the toilets becomes an expedition to a haunted house, well then you've entered the wonderful world of Eliot Kid!

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other' s company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.desc: Max Green's new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he's the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

programme.desc: The moment you step onto the island of Barbados you are wrapped in warmth, sun, and surf, but for travel writers filing stories that means turning vacation activities into story ideas. Robin attacks the turquoise waves from various angles with a Bajan surfing legend while Julia spends a little time up-close and personal with endangered, Hawksbill Turtles.

programme.title: Word Travels
programme.sub-title: the Truth Behind the Byline - Portugal: Blindfolds and Bulls

Back over the North Atlantic to Lisbon, our writers explore alternative city tours, including a remarkable sightseeing tour that offers no sight at all.

programme.title: The Wine Guys: Grape Escapes
programme.desc: Set in idyllic Tuscany, Italy, we grasp the ideal altitude for growing grapes at the Tenuta Buon Tempo winery - 250 metres above sea level.

programme.title: The Wine Guys: Grape Escapes
programme.desc: Episode Six kicks off in La Mancha, Spain at Bodegas Isidro Milagro. Michael and Charlie step into a wine factory - one that produces over 100 million liters of wine a year. Charlie has some fun creating his own wine in their laboratory, and The Wine Guys survive an unexpected hailstorm! After drying off, the guys head up country to visit Alto Landon, an organic winery in the hills of Castilla La Mancha.

programme.title: Bon Appetit: Gerard Depardieu's Europe

programme.title: Waterfront Cities of The World

The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: Bering Sea Gold
programme.sub-title: Shawn unleashes the Christine Rose to try and find a lucrative riverbed. Vernon's new crew go for a test dive, but the practice takes a dark turn
programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. This series, from the creators of the Emmy-winning \"Deadliest Catch,\" follows four gold dredges and their eccentric and driven crews who risk their lives to find as much gold as possible before winter sets in and it's too dangerous to dive. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: The Mind Control Freaks

programme.desc: Mind control is a phenomenon that not everyone necessarily believes in, but this programme may make more people think it's real with some of the mind manipulations that are featured.
